entities.name: Kuniko Mukōda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kuniko Mukōda  was a Japanese TV screenwriter. Most of her scripts focus on day-to-day family life and relationships. She won the 83rd Naoki Prize (1980上) for her short stories "Hanano Namae", "Kawauso" and "Inugoya."
